Maria L.: Quick intake — brought up sparrow7b-int8 on dev-stg (quant pipeline v2). Seeing inconsistent completions when we hit cached prefixes; fresh prompts are fine but responses diverge once the KV cache is reused. Low priority but reproducible.
Ajit P.: can you paste the minimal repro? prompt + config
Maria L.: repro below. Ran on node dev-gpu-12, model sparrow7b quant int8-ptq. Command:
```bash
./run_infer --model=sparrow7b.int8 --kv-cache=on --batch=1 --seed=42 \ 
  --prompts-file=smoke_prompts.txt --quant-profile=ptq_v3
```
Example input+outputs (fresh vs cached):
fresh: "Summarize the article in two bullets." -> "Key points: ..."
cached (second request using same prefix): "Summarize the article in two bullets." -> "In conclusion, the period..." (wrong tone and repeats)
Logs around the moment:
```text
[2026-11-12T14:02:11Z] INFO runtime: kv cache hit for key 0x7f9a
[2026-11-12T14:02:11Z] WARN quant: small negative attention weights after dequantization -> clamp
[2026-11-12T14:02:12Z] DEBUG kernels: selected int8_gemm_v2 for qkv
[2026-11-12T14:02:12Z] ERROR runtime: kv-merge mismatch (expected len 512 got 504)
```
Zack R.: hmm kv-merge mismatch sounds like length alignment bug. Are you using dynamic padding? Or did PTQ alter the kv stride?
Maria L.: using dynamic padding; prompts vary in length. I ran with --pad-to=32 and the mismatch persisted. The error shows expected 512 (8 heads * 64?) but 504 is 8 * 63 -> off by one token per head.
Ajit P.: That suggests quantized kernel might be assuming a fixed group size (64) but PTQ pipeline produced a rounding to 63 for some shards. Can you run with --kv-check-mode=strict (dev flag) to dump per-head lengths and raw int outputs? Also include the small eval harness diff i asked for earlier.
Maria L.: running now. FYI ci-bot reports smoke job 128 failed 1/40 for int8 profile earlier.
ci-bot: [job/infra-smoke-128] sparrow7b.int8 - failures: 1 tests failed (kv-cache-merge), see https://ci/internal/128
deploy-bot: nightly-quant-v2 deployed to dev-stg at 14:00 UTC
Zack R.: if you can reproduce locally, try disabling prefix cache as a workaround: --kv-cache=off and compare token-by-token logits. If logits diverge post-dequant, it's kernel rounding.
Maria L.: ran --kv-check-mode=strict. Dump attached (excerpt):
```text
HEAD 0 len_expected=64 len_actual=63
HEAD 1 len_expected=64 len_actual=63
...
per-head quant_scale = [0.0123,0.0123,0.0122,...]
post-dequant max_abs_diff ~ 2.3e-2 for some heads
```
Maria L.: With --kv-cache=off, completions match baseline int16 run. With cache on, mismatch appears at the first reuse and grows.
Ajit P.: OK looks like a stride/padding bug in int8_gemm_v2 kernel when merging KV shapes that aren't a multiple of 64. Short-term: gate cache for this profile or force pad-to-head-multiple (e.g., --pad-to-head=64). Long-term: I'll open a kernel ticket.
Zack R.: also add a quick eval: run the 50-shot qreg bench and capture top-1 token diffs, especially on completion prefix reuse.
Maria L.: scheduling a quick follow-up run and will mute kv-cache for prod-like pipelines until fix. Filing TODO in model intake: mark sparrow7b.int8 as "kv-cache-disabled" and note PTQ_v3 quirk.
Ajit P.: thanks. Can you add the minimal reproducer to the model's intake notes and paste the ci link? I'll triage kernel change with infra.
Maria L.: added note and CI link: https://ci/internal/128 — assigning to Ajit. Will ping again when evals finish. :thumbsup:
